name: A data feed changed

Public EuroLeague endpoints are undocumented and change between seasons. This is
expected, and fixing it means updating an adapter in `src/elfantasy/data/`.

**Which command, and what did it report?**
Run with `--verbose` and paste the log lines.

**Which feed?**
- [ ] schedule / results
- [ ] box scores
- [ ] rosters
- [ ] odds
- [ ] fantasy prices

**Sample of the raw payload** (a few records is plenty — please redact any API key)

```json
```
